nodes.label: Amore — Designer Jewelry Catalogue
nodes.rationale: Free-tier, WhatsApp-first jewellery catalogue with staff manager panel. Single-page catalogue by design (Constitution Principle III): no cart, checkout, or payment; every enquiry over WhatsApp. Wishlist stored in localStorage only, no user accounts on the public site. All seeded staff accounts have equal permissions; no role hierarchy (Constitution Principle V).

nodes.label: Spec 001 — Amore Jewelry Catalogue
nodes.rationale: Cited as the authoritative spec, plan, data model, and contracts this app was built from (../specs/001-amore-jewelry-catalogue/).

nodes.label: Constitution Principle III
nodes.rationale: Single-page catalogue by design — the reason there is no cart, checkout, or payment.

nodes.label: Constitution Principle V
nodes.rationale: No role hierarchy — all staff accounts have equal permissions.

nodes.label: Single-Page Catalogue Design
nodes.rationale: Single-page catalogue by design: no cart, checkout, or payment; every product enquiry happens over WhatsApp.

nodes.label: Flat Staff Permission Model
nodes.rationale: All three seeded staff accounts have equal permissions, deliberately avoiding a role hierarchy.

nodes.label: WhatsApp-First Enquiry Flow
nodes.rationale: Every product enquiry happens over WhatsApp via wa.me links built from the business WhatsApp number.

nodes.label: localStorage Wishlist
nodes.rationale: Wishlist stored in localStorage only; no user accounts on the public site.

nodes.label: TDD Workflow (red → green → refactor)
nodes.rationale: Test-Driven Development is applied to every change: red, green, refactor.

nodes.label: seed-emulator script
nodes.rationale: Seeds with placeholder categories, collections, style tags, 20 mock products, and 3 staff accounts (owner@amore.test, staff1@amore.test, staff2@amore.test, password password123). For local development only.

nodes.label: pwa.config.ts
nodes.rationale: Shared PWA manifest used by vite.config.ts and its own test.

nodes.label: Security Rules Test Suite (Vitest)
nodes.rationale: Tests Firestore/Storage security rules against a throwaway emulator instance (npm run test:rules).

nodes.label: VITE_WHATSAPP_NUMBER
nodes.rationale: Business WhatsApp number in E.164 without the + prefix, used to build wa.me enquiry links.

nodes.label: VITE_USE_EMULATOR
nodes.rationale: true for local dev, false/omitted for production; points the app at local emulators instead of real Firebase.

nodes.label: VITE_FIREBASE_* config
nodes.rationale: Firebase web app config; placeholder values allowed for local dev since VITE_USE_EMULATOR=true routes to local emulators.

nodes.label: JDK 21+
nodes.rationale: Required by the Firebase Emulator Suite.

nodes.label: Seeded Staff Accounts
nodes.rationale: Three staff accounts (owner@amore.test, staff1@amore.test, staff2@amore.test, password password123), all with equal permission.
